description: Before complex execution, Master should form a lightweight Five-Layer Runtime Snapshot to check model, harness, prompt, skill, and RAG/memory fitness.
triggerCondition: A task is classified as complex, high-risk, long-running, or quality-critical.
expectedBehavior: Master must assess fitness for each of the five layers.
Each layer fit must be one of: sufficient, partial, weak, unknown.
If a layer is partial, weak, or unknown, Master must note what is missing or required.
The snapshot must inform the Execution Contract or task analysis.
Simple tasks may use lightweight implicit checks instead of a full snapshot.
forbiddenBehavior: Skipping layer assessment for complex tasks.
Assuming all layers are sufficient without checking.
Treating the snapshot as a mandatory schema for simple tasks.
